result.summary: This residential street features a narrow sidewalk that is poorly maintained with significant weed growth and encroaching vegetation. There is no visible pedestrian-scale lighting or traffic calming infrastructure, and the walkway lacks a buffer from on-street parking.

hazards.name: Overgrown Vegetation
hazards.description: Weeds and tall grass are growing through the sidewalk pavement, reducing the effective walking width.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow residential street with row houses and continuous parallel parking on both sides. While paved sidewalks are present and in good condition, the environment lacks dedicated pedestrian safety features like marked crossings or traffic calming measures.

hazards.name: Parked Car Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the street creates a visual barrier between the sidewalk and the travel lane, making it difficult for drivers to see pedestrians entering the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the street along the entire visible block.

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Calming
hazards.description: The straight, unobstructed travel lane may encourage higher vehicle speeds than appropriate for a residential neighborhood.
hazards.location_in_image: Center travel lane.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the ends of the block to increase pedestrian visibility and reduce the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Install speed humps to physically limit vehicle speeds to a safe level for a residential environment.

result.summary: This residential street features narrow sidewalks that are directly adjacent to the roadway without a buffer. The pedestrian environment is significantly compromised by utility poles located in the middle of the walkway, creating obstructions for those with mobility needs.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Multiple utility poles are placed directly in the center of the narrow sidewalk, blocking the clear path for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Center-left and center-right on the sidewalk

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: There is no physical separation or planting strip between the narrow sidewalk and the active roadway/parking lane.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the entire visible curb line

hazards.name: Tripping Hazards
hazards.description: Cracked pavement and vegetation growth in the sidewalk joints create uneven surfaces.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground sidewalk area

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the curb into the parking lane to widen the sidewalk, allowing the utility poles to be bypassed while maintaining a clear walking path.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Implement a dedicated furniture zone or planting strip to house utility poles and provide a buffer between pedestrians and vehicles.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair and level the existing sidewalk to remove tripping hazards and improve accessibility.
